newsitem.title: BULGARIA: NO CORPORATE STOCKS TRADE ON BULGARIA BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: NO CORPORATE STOCKS TRADE ON BULGARIA BOURSE.

text.p: No corporate stocks traded on Bulgarian bourses for an eleventh day in row and the RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Friday's 41.28 points, brokers said.
No repo deals in treasury paper were struck either.
The Sofia-based Sofia Stock Exchange (SSE), the country's second largest, suspended daily trading today, an exchange official said.
Brokers said that the bourse probably would not resume trading as a planned merger with the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE) was expected to materialise.
The SSE shareholders approved the merger in principle in January but no specific action has been taken so far, exchange officials said.
The BSE was set up in December last year through a merger of five local bourses.
